methods.label: Angle notation rules
methods.explanation: When an angle is named using three uppercase letters, the vertex letter is written in the middle, and \(\angle AOB\) and \(\angle BOA\) are the same angle. When there are multiple angles at a vertex, the vertex letter alone cannot be used to name an angle. \(\angle 1\) is an angle named using a number.
methods.levelReason: Uses standard Grade 7 angle notation without additional theory.
